verdict.rationale: gstack publishes a docs/skills.md page listing its bundled skills with one-line descriptions (office-hours, plan reviews, design system, spec, debugging). A developer can browse it on GitHub before installing, so it works as a static catalog of first-party skills. It is not a searchable registry, leaderboard, or marketplace of third-party skills, and the git-clone-and-copy install model brings in the whole pack rather than letting you pick from a listing. Missing for 10: searchable registry or marketplace, third-party or community skill listings, ranking or leaderboard, and selective install from a catalog.
